notes: Reached via Chrome connector, no block encountered. robots.txt (https://www.surlatable.com/robots.txt) has no ClaudeBot/Claude-User/anthropic-ai group and no full-site disallow -- only disallows cart/checkout/search/facet-filter paths, none of which affect this extraction. Sur La Table is a kitchenware/tableware specialist with a purely product-type taxonomy (Cookware, Bakeware, Kitchen Tools, Knives, Small Appliances, Coffee & Tea, Dining & Bar, Kitchen & Decor, Food, Outdoor) and no room-based furniture department, matching the prior Home-Decor pass's structural notes. To earn the near-absence finding, cross-checked the full category sitemap (sitemap_0.xml, 1479 <loc> entries) with a furniture-keyword regex (furniture, sofa, chair, table, bed, desk, cabinet, wardrobe, stool, bench, dresser, shelving, bookcase, seating, island, cart, stand, nightstand, ottoman, loveseat, sectional -- word-boundary aware) after excluding 'Sur La Table' brand-name false positives on 'table'. Result: exactly one genuinely furniture-typed category slug exists site-wide -- /products/kitchen-decor/home-essentials/kitchen-islands-carts/. All other keyword hits were non-furniture: 'baking-cabinet' is a food/baking-ingredients category, 'tablecloths-runners' and 'tabletop' are linens. Also walked the full /products/outdoor/ branch (27 sitemap URLs) and confirmed zero outdoor-furniture nodes -- only grilling/cookware, outdoor dining & entertaining (glassware/dinnerware/linens), and picnic/camping. Ran a discrimination search for 'bar stool': the site returned only an unrelated 'OXO Steel 6-Piece Bar Tool Set' (fuzzy text match), confirming a genuine absence of stool/chair seating rather than a search false-negative. The one furniture leaf found, Kitchen Islands & Carts, sits under the excluded 'Home Essentials' branch (which is otherwise cleaning supplies/dish racks/towels/totes -- correctly out of scope) so no grouping row is emitted for Home Essentials; the leaf is recorded directly under top bucket 'Furniture'. Qty for that leaf: rendered header '11 Items' corroborated by the same page's pagination summary 'Showing 11 of 11' (two independent on-page sources agree). The node's 11 products are dominated by John Boos maple butcher-block prep tables/islands (thick wood tops on stainless steel bases with casters and storage shelves -- genuine furniture, filed by the site itself under Kitchen Islands & Carts) plus a Yamazaki rolling steel cart and a Cuisinart outdoor table/grill stand; one of the 11 (John Boos Mystery Oil, a wood-conditioner) is a non-furniture accessory cross-merchandised into this node, but per project rule qty is the site's own exact count for the URL, not a manually filtered count, so 11 stands. Excluded as out of scope, consistent with the prior pass and this pass's own sitemap check: all Cookware/Bakeware/Knives/Kitchen Tools/Small Appliances/Coffee & Tea/Food, Flatware, Bar Tools & Ice/Wine Buckets, all Linens, the rest of Home Essentials (cleaning, dish racks, totes, floor mats, pets), Countertop Organization, Spoonrests & Trivets, Cookbooks, and all Outdoor Cookware/Dining/Glassware/Dinnerware/Linens/Picnic branches.
